offline_evidence.interpretation: Owned local synthetic fixture evidence supports this reader regression fix. It is not production HTTP, SSH, service inventory, cutover or admission qualification.

limits: S.open_parent rejects symlink traversal but does not establish trusted owner/mode for every ancestor or revalidate the full current pathname after ancestor renames.
FD pinning, metadata comparisons and the post-read linked-name check are consistency checks, not an atomic snapshot against arbitrary concurrent writers.
Private ownership is not a security boundary against code under the same UID or higher privilege. Metadata timestamps must not be advertised as a cryptographic content guarantee against such actors.
Parent timestamps are not compared; exposure-and-restore of parent permissions between checkpoints is outside the guaranteed boundary.
Neither actual installed credential nor live loopback transport was accessed by this reviewer.
